idalia.basis: Immediate anomaly +0.046 and swing +0.031 are positive; footprint NDVI did not fall (0.446 in Aug 2023 to 0.447 in Sep 2023). Companion scar share 0.020, below the 0.10 detection threshold. Power: 936 vegetated footprint pixels on an 85.4 ha cluster; placebo swing SD 0.025, 2.5th percentile -0.041, full range -0.055 to +0.057, so an Ida-magnitude swing (-0.074) lies beyond every placebo draw and would have been detected. This is a powered null, not an underpowered case.

florence.basis: Immediate anomaly +0.041 and swing +0.011 are positive; footprint NDVI rose through landfall (0.510 in the landfall-straddling Sep 2018 composite to 0.521 in Oct 2018). Companion scar share 0.006, far below the 0.10 threshold. Power caveat: 499 vegetated footprint pixels on a 45.0 ha cluster, but the placebo swing distribution is wide (SD 0.047, 2.5th percentile -0.104), so an Ida-magnitude swing (-0.074) would NOT have cleared the placebo criterion at 5 percent. The point estimate is a clean null; the case cannot exclude an Ida-size effect and is reported as null with limited sensitivity, between Helene's underpowered case and Idalia's powered null.
